description: This Python source file defines a Sphinx extension module that provides Git and GitHub related utilities, including functions to generate URLs for source code, issues, and retrieve last commit info for documentation pages. It also sets up Jinja filters for use in Sphinx HTML builds.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Sphinx extension, adding configuration values and connecting the 'add_jinja_filter' function to the 'builder-inited' event.

methods.name: add_jinja_filter
methods.description: Adds custom Jinja filters to the Sphinx HTML builder environment for URL generation and git info retrieval.

methods.name: git_info_filter
methods.description: Retrieves the last commit date and SHA1 for a documentation page if tracked by git.

methods.name: gh_link_get_url
methods.description: Generates a GitHub URL for viewing or editing a documentation page based on configuration.

methods.name: gh_link_get_open_issue_url
methods.description: Constructs a URL to open a new GitHub issue related to a documentation page, pre-filled with context.

methods.name: get_page_prefix
methods.description: Determines the repository prefix for a page, considering exclusions and patterns.
